metadata.title: [DEMO DATA] AWS IAM and S3 access controls — sample results

import_ap.remarks: Demo data: no assessment plan exists.

observations.description: [DEMO DATA] [DEMO DATA — synthetic evidence] Design and implementation: at the time of the read, the sample password policy meets the length requirement in the test step. Operating effectiveness over the period was not tested.
[DEMO DATA] [DEMO DATA — no evidence] No available evidence tool covers this control (review sign-offs are held outside AWS), so it was not tested. This is a scope limitation, not a deficiency.
[DEMO DATA] [DEMO DATA — synthetic evidence] One of three sample buckets does not block public ACLs; the control is not implemented as designed.
